Definition: primary visual cortex grey matter volume summed/estimated across both hemispheres
Note: units printed mm3 but values scale as cm3; primary visual from de Sousa et al. 2010 [S6]; use unsuffixed bilateral term

Definition: prefrontal cortex grey matter proxy summed across both hemispheres
Note: cumulative volume of the ANTERIOR 5 of 20 frontal sections (Smaers 2011 Suppl. Table 2); not the whole cytoarchitectonic prefrontal cortex; cm3

Definition: other cortical association areas grey-matter residual across both hemispheres
Note: derived as neocortex minus WHOLE frontal lobe minus primary visual (not minus prefrontal + frontal motor); cm3
Source Note: Smaers 2017 Supplemental Experimental Procedures Data section

Definition: frontal motor areas grey-matter proxy summed across both hemispheres
Note: cumulative volume of the POSTERIOR 5 of 20 frontal sections; not the complement of prefrontal and not independently printed in Smaers 2011; cm3

Definition: primary visual cortex white matter volume across both hemispheres
Note: units printed mm3 but values scale as cm3; use unsuffixed bilateral term

Definition: prefrontal cortex white-matter proxy summed across both hemispheres
Note: anterior-5-of-20-section proxy; not whole cytoarchitectonic prefrontal white matter; cm3

Definition: other cortical association areas white-matter residual across both hemispheres
Note: derived as neocortex minus WHOLE frontal lobe minus primary visual; cm3
Source Note: Smaers 2017 Supplemental Experimental Procedures Data section

Definition: frontal motor areas white-matter proxy summed across both hemispheres
Note: posterior-5-of-20-section proxy; not the complement of prefrontal; cm3
compiled from Smaers 2010 [S1] + Smaers 2011 [S2] + de Sousa 2010 [S6]; not newly measured

Definition: prefrontal + frontal motor do NOT sum to the whole frontal lobe: they are the anterior-5 and posterior-5 of 20 frontal sections (the two ends); the ~10 middle sections are in neither, so the sum is ~37% of total frontal-lobe volume. For whole frontal lobe use Smaers_etal_2011 Suppl. Table 1.
the supplement labels all volumes mm3; the values are in fact cm3 (they reproduce Smaers 2011 cm3 exactly). Snapshot keeps the printed mm3 label; treat as cm3 downstream.
